authorization: Temporary safe shutdown of both remaining local stacks; isolated backend and smoke only; intensive tests reserved for manual execution

resources.note: Host memory fluctuates with external processes; net host change is not a controlled measure of container memory released
resources.workingSetNote: Point observations, not private committed RAM; sums may include shared pages

lab.remainingBlocker: Host free memory below unchanged 4 GiB minimum; live fixture provisioning and smoke remain unvalidated

validation.sharedDataOptimization: Separate SharedArrays for actors, tenants, writes and conflict cases; no complete dataset deserialization per iteration
validation.bodyPolicy: Discard by default, explicitly retain bodies for every request whose business payload must be checked

manualProcedure.reason: Backend, real synthetic Auth fixtures and safety marker must be provisioned and smoke-tested first
manualProcedure.nextAction: Owner can voluntarily free additional application memory; repeat guarded preflight before and after lab startup, then finish live fixtures and smoke

finalPreflight.scope: Read-only host readiness; no backend or load execution

safetyPolicy.loadProbe: Repeat after backend startup; supervisor enforces the same remaining host margin

finalPreflight.note: Host readiness is not authorization to run; an owned independent lab and synthetic fixtures must be verified separately.
